title: Mission and configuration
requirement: SHALL Define approved mission, occupancy, envelope and modular cabin interfaces.
acceptance_criterion: Review mission/configuration matrix and interface drawings; no geometry inferred from the image.

title: Mass and centre of gravity
requirement: SHALL Maintain a mass/CG budget for cabin, hydrogen tanks, fuel cell, battery and propulsion in each loading case.
acceptance_criterion: Review all approved loading cases against selected flight-envelope limits.

title: Hydrogen storage and isolation
requirement: SHALL Define hydrogen storage, isolation, ventilation, leak detection and maintenance interfaces with a recorded hazard analysis.
acceptance_criterion: Review hazards and planned leak/isolation tests against limits selected before testing.

title: Hybrid electric power and thermal control
requirement: SHALL Specify fuel-cell, buffer battery, conversion, motor and cooling interfaces including peak demand and loss-of-source cases.
acceptance_criterion: Analyse mission energy and thermal budgets; bench-test selected operating and fault cases.

title: Rotor and flight dynamics
requirement: SHALL Model rotor/airframe aerodynamics, stability and flight dynamics for the approved envelope.
acceptance_criterion: Compare model outputs with identified reference data and approved error tolerances.

title: Authority and fault response
requirement: SHALL Keep local flight authority separate from supervisory analytics and define degraded modes and emergency responses.
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate fault scenarios in simulation with operator review and recorded mode transitions.

title: Digital twin and replay
requirement: SHALL Version configuration and models; timestamp and quality-tag telemetry; keep observed and simulated states separate.
acceptance_criterion: Replay synthetic events with duplicate, stale and missing samples; verify identity, provenance and state separation.
